modules.name: clear_tree_pillar
modules.description: Clears a whole tree (its logs and leaves, within 3 blocks of the trunk) including parts too high to reach: picks the tree trunk nearest the bot, breaks what it can reach from the ground, then stands in the trunk column and pillars up with blocks from the inventory (dirt/cobble/planks/logs), breaking everything in reach at each level. Then it climbs down one block at a time by breaking the pillar under itself (filling any gap below first, so it never falls more than 1 block), leaving no placed blocks. Needs a few placeable blocks in the inventory.

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: tree_at_30_cleared
modules.description: No *_log or *_leaves seen within 3 blocks horizontally of the tree at [30,-60,-12] (y -61..-50), bot within 6 blocks of the trunk column.
modules.code: (s) => { const c = [30, -57, -12]; if (dist(s.self.pos, c) > 6) return false; const globs = ["*_log", "*_leaves"]; const suf = globs.map(g => g.slice(1)); const isTree = (n) => suf.some(x => n.endsWith(x)); for (const n of Object.keys(s.blocks)) { if (!isTree(n)) continue; for (const p of s.blocks[n]) { if (Math.abs(p[0] - 30) <= 3 && Math.abs(p[2] + 12) <= 3 && p[1] >= -61 && p[1] <= -50) return false; } } if ((s.crowded || []).some(isTree)) return false; return true; }

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: has_wooden_pickaxe
modules.description: The bot holds at least one wooden pickaxe in its inventory.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest

modules.name: pickaxe_deposited
modules.description: Bot within 6 blocks of a seen chest and carries no wooden pickaxe.
modules.code: (s) => { const c = (s.blocks.chest||[]); const near = c.some(p => dist(p, s.self.pos) <= 6); return near && !((s.inventory.wooden_pickaxe||0) > 0); }

origin.goal: g-3: put the wooden pickaxe in the chest

modules.name: clear_floating_leaves_pillar
modules.description: Clears a floating leaf cluster (no trunk under it) that is too high to reach: picks the cluster of the target block nearest the bot, stands on the ground under its middle, pillars up with blocks from the inventory (dirt/cobble/planks/logs), breaking every target block in reach at each level, then climbs down by breaking the pillar under itself (filling any gap first, never falling more than 1 block), leaving no placed blocks. Needs a few placeable blocks.

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: craft_item_from_wood
modules.description: Crafts the target item (count) from the inventory, resolving recipes recursively: logs -> planks -> sticks etc. For 3x3 recipes it uses a reachable crafting table within 16 blocks, or crafts one and places it on the ground next to the bot. If logs are missing it chops the trunk of the nearest natural tree (trunk standing on dirt/grass with leaves) reachable from the ground and picks up the drops.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest

modules.name: deposit_pickaxe_in_chest
modules.description: Walks to the nearest reachable chest (within 16 blocks), opens it, deposits only the wooden_pickaxe(s) from the inventory (keeps everything else), and closes the chest. Never breaks the chest.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest
